make.name: Škoda
make.description: Czech carmaker founded in 1895 and part of the Volkswagen Group since 1991. Its electric range runs from the Epiq and Elroq to the Enyaq and the seven-seat Peaq, all built on Volkswagen Group platforms.

models.name: Citigo-e iV
models.description: Battery-electric version of the Citigo city car and Škoda's first production EV, a rebadged Volkswagen e-up! built in Bratislava. It replaced the petrol Citigo in 2019 and sales ended in 2020.

generations.name: Citigo-e iV
generations.description: Electric-only Citigo with a 36.8 kWh battery and 61 kW motor.

models.name: Enyaq
models.description: Mid-size electric SUV and Škoda's first MEB-based model, built in Mladá Boleslav since November 2020 (sold as Enyaq iV until 2024). It was facelifted in January 2025 with the Modern Solid front, and updated again in mid-2026 with Android Automotive infotainment and new 58 kWh LFP entry battery.

generations.name: First generation (Enyaq iV)
generations.description: Original Enyaq iV with 50/60/80/80x/RS versions; the 2024 model year brought the 210 kW 85 and 85x and a 250 kW RS.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: January 2025 facelift with the Modern Solid front design and lower drag; mid-2026 update (2027 model) adds a 58 kWh LFP 60, 220 kW 85x and Android Automotive.

models.name: Enyaq Coupé
models.description: Coupe-roofed version of the Enyaq, built on the same Mladá Boleslav line since February 2022 (originally Enyaq Coupé iV). Facelifted with the Enyaq in January 2025.

generations.name: First generation (Enyaq Coupé iV)
generations.description: Original Enyaq Coupé iV, including the first RS; 2024 model year brought 85/85x and the 250 kW RS.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: January 2025 facelift (Modern Solid front, drag down to Cd 0.225).

models.name: Elroq
models.description: Compact electric SUV on the MEB platform, unveiled in October 2024 as the first Škoda in the Modern Solid design and built in Mladá Boleslav since January 2025. It was Europe's second-best-selling EV in 2025; a mid-2026 update added an LFP 60 and Android Automotive.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Launched with 50, 60 and 85, then 85x and RS (2025); 2027 model year from mid-2026 brings a 58 kWh LFP 60.

models.name: Epiq
models.description: Front-wheel-drive subcompact electric SUV on the MEB+ (MEB Entry) platform, built at Volkswagen Navarra in Pamplona since June 2026 alongside the VW ID. Cross. It is Škoda's smallest electric SUV.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Production from June 2026; 37 kWh LFP (Epiq 35/40) and 55 kWh NMC (Epiq 55) batteries.

models.name: Peaq
models.description: Large five- or seven-seat electric SUV, the production version of the 2022 Vision 7S concept. Built in Mladá Boleslav on the MEB+ platform and on sale since August 2026.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Production from August 2026; 63/59 kWh and 91/86 kWh NMC batteries, rear- or all-wheel drive.

Elroq 50 is listed as 'not listed' for the 2027 model year on Wikipedia; its end date is not confirmed, so it is left without year_to.
ev-database also lists newer 'Elroq 85 84 kWh' and 'Enyaq 85 84 kWh' entries that could not be read.

Citigo-e iV WLTP: ev-database 258 km vs Wikipedia 270 km; used ev-database. Discontinuation (autumn 2020) is sourced only to Wikipedia.
